How do you ensure semantic equivalence between the mDoc and SD-JWT-VC encodings of the same PID — are both formats generated from a single canonical source?

VEND-ISS-027.text: Do you offer attestations in all formats required by the applicable Rulebook? How do you determine which formats are mandatory vs optional for each attestation type?
How do you track Rulebook changes that add new mandatory formats — is there an automated monitoring mechanism, or manual review?
Do you validate format correctness against Rulebook specifications — is there pre-issuance format validation (structure, encoding, mandatory fields)?
How do you ensure encoding consistency across different formats (mDoc CBOR vs SD-JWT-VC JSON) — are attribute values semantically equivalent in both encodings?
Per AS-AP-10-017, if you support revocation chaining, how do you ensure the attestation expiration date does not exceed the WUA expiration date presented during issuance?
Per AS-AP-10-039, do you implement device binding for all attestations? How does the binding mechanism differ between mDoc (mdoc authentication) and SD-JWT-VC (cnf claim)?
When a Rulebook adds a new mandatory format, what is the expected lead time for your platform to support it? Is there a phased rollout process?
Do you support issuing the same attestation in multiple formats simultaneously (batch dual-format issuance) or must the user request each format separately?
How do you handle optional formats — can the organisation choose to issue in additional formats beyond the Rulebook mandate (e.g., W3C VCDM v2.0 per EW-DM-12-005)?

VEND-ISS-028.text: Do you implement attestation revocation as specified in the applicable Rulebook? How do you determine the revocation method(s) required for each attestation type (per AS-AP-07-003)?
Do you meet the Rulebook-specified maximum propagation times for revocation status updates? What are your actual P50/P99 propagation latencies?
Do you support suspension where the Rulebook requires it? Is suspension treated as distinct from revocation in your status list mechanism (per AS-AP-07-006 irreversibility)?
How do you adapt revocation implementation when Rulebook specifications change — is there a change management process for revocation method updates?
Per AS-AP-07-004/AS-AP-07-005, how do you ensure the attestation provider retains sole responsibility for the revocation decision, even when operation is outsourced to a third party?
Per AS-AP-07-006, how do you technically enforce revocation irreversibility — once an attestation is revoked, is it impossible to reverse at any level (API, database, administrative override)?
Can revocation propagation time targets be configured per attestation type to accommodate Rulebook-specific requirements (e.g., 1 hour for QEAA vs 24 hours for non-qualified EAA)?
How do you handle the scenario where a Rulebook specifies that a non-qualified EAA type is NOT revocable — do you omit revocation infrastructure for that type?
Do you provide per-Rulebook revocation compliance reports showing actual propagation times vs Rulebook-specified maximums?

VEND-ISS-029.text: How do you ensure registration information remains accurate in Member State registries — is there periodic validation against the actual operational state?
What is the process for updating registration information when changes occur — API-driven, portal-based, or manual submission to the registry operator?

Who is responsible for maintaining registration information — the organisation directly, or does the vendor manage it on behalf of the organisation?
How do you alert the organisation to registration information that may be out of date — proactive staleness monitoring, periodic reminders, or manual checks?
Per AS-MS-27-017, how do you maintain the ability to revoke access certificates when registration information changes? Is access certificate lifecycle managed automatically?
What types of registration information changes are supported — organisational (name, legal entity), technical (endpoints, formats), key rotation (new certificates), operational (status)?
Is there a change audit trail showing who updated registration information, when, and what was changed?
How do you handle registration updates for organisations operating in multiple Member States — must each MS registry be updated independently, or is there a federated update mechanism?

VEND-ISS-030.text: Do you publish trust anchor information according to the Commission's common format (per AS-MS-31-007/AS-MS-31-008)? Is the publication automated and machine-readable?
Per AS-WP-31-001, what information is included in the published trust anchor — identification data, trust anchor public keys, Access Certificate Authority trust anchors, service supply points?
How do wallets and RPs access your trust anchor information — via Trusted List lookup, direct endpoint, or both? What protocol is used (HTTPS, LDAP)?
What is the process for Trusted List inclusion of your trust anchor (per AS-MS-31-011) — how long does initial inclusion typically take, and what documentation is required?
How do you handle trust anchor updates during key rotation — is the new public key published before the old key is deactivated to ensure continuous verifiability?
What is the uptime SLA for trust anchor endpoints? Is there geographic redundancy to ensure availability across all Member States?
Per AS-MS-31-013, if the organisation is a public body, do you support the additional notification requirements (legal basis, mandate scope)?
How do you handle trust anchor lifecycle events (signing key rotation, endpoint changes, provider status changes, Access Certificate Authority changes) — is the update propagation automated?
Do you provide monitoring of trust anchor publication health — alerts for endpoint downtime, certificate expiry, or Trusted List desynchronisation?

VEND-ISS-031.text: Do you verify the Wallet Unit Attestation (WUA) before issuing PIDs or device-bound attestations? Is WUA verification mandatory for all issuance flows, or configurable per attestation type?
Per AS-WP-09-015, how do you verify that the WSCA/WSCD has proven possession of the new attestation private key — challenge-response, signed nonce, or other mechanism?
What WUA verification checks do you perform — signature validation, certificate chain validation, revocation status check, WSCD certification level verification, expiry check?
How do you handle issuance requests from wallets with invalid or revoked WUAs — reject with specific error code, log the attempt, alert the Wallet Provider?
How do you stay updated on certified WSCD lists and WUA trust anchors — automated synchronisation, manual updates, or Trusted List-based resolution?
What is the latency impact of WUA verification on the issuance process? Do you cache Wallet Provider certificates and WUA revocation status to minimise overhead?
Per AS-WP-09-026, how do you ensure compliance with all relevant requirements in Technical Specification 3 (Wallet Unit Attestation)? Do you have a TS3 conformance test suite?
How do you handle WUA verification failure due to network issues (e.g., revocation status endpoint unreachable) — fail-open, fail-closed, or configurable policy?
Do you log WUA verification results for audit purposes — including which checks passed/failed, the Wallet Provider identity, and WSCD certification level?

VEND-ISS-032.text: Do you support embedding disclosure policies in issued attestations per EW-PIO-43-001? Are policies included by value (not by reference) in the Issuer metadata via OpenID4VCI?
How do you define disclosure policies for different attestation types — per-attestation-type configuration, per-Rulebook default, or fully customisable per issuance?
Per AS-AP-43-001, how do you handle the requirement to revoke attestations when a corresponding embedded disclosure policy is added, changed, or deleted? Is this automated?
How do Wallet Units interpret and enforce embedded disclosure policies — have you tested policy enforcement across multiple wallet implementations?
Can the organisation customise disclosure policies for their attestation types — mandatory vs optional attributes, purpose limitations, RP category restrictions?
What guidance do you provide on best practices for disclosure policy design — templates, validation tools, compliance checks against data minimisation principles?
How do you handle the disclosure policy lifecycle — versioning, deprecation of old policies, migration of existing attestations when policies change?
What is the encoding format for embedded disclosure policies — JSON-based, CBOR-based, or format-specific (different for mDoc vs SD-JWT-VC)?
Do you provide tooling for organisations to preview how a disclosure policy will affect the user experience in wallets before deployment?

VEND-ISS-033.text: Do you use registration certificates for Provider authentication in Wallet Unit interactions? Is the certificate included in Issuer metadata per AS-AP-44-004?
Per AS-AP-44-002, how do you distribute the registration certificate to all service supply points — is distribution automated when a new certificate is issued or rotated?
Per AS-AP-44-004, is the registration certificate included by value (not by reference) in your Issuer metadata? This ensures issuance transactions are atomic and self-contained.
How do you manage registration certificate lifecycle — automated renewal before expiry, revocation on registration status change, key rotation procedures?
What certificate types do you support as registration certificates — X.509, JWT-based, or other formats specified in the technical specifications?
How are registration certificates validated by Wallet Units during issuance — certificate chain resolution, revocation status check, trust anchor lookup?
What happens if the registration certificate expires or is revoked during operations — immediate issuance halt, graceful degradation with warning, or automatic renewal?
How do you handle registration certificate updates without downtime — dual-certificate overlap period, rolling deployment, or scheduled maintenance window?
Do you monitor registration certificate expiry proactively — alerts at 90/60/30 days before expiry, automated renewal triggers?

VEND-ISS-034.text: Do you issue PIDs in SD-JWT VC format compliant with ARF specifications? Is the `vct` claim correctly set to a URN within the `urn:eudi:pid:` namespace (per EW-DM-03-14)?
Do you include all required SD-JWT VC claims — `vct`, `iss`, `iat`, `exp`, `cnf` (key binding), `status` (revocation reference) — per EW-DM-03-17?
How do you encode PID attributes per EW-DM-03-18/EW-DM-03-19 — JSON claim encoding per the PID Rulebook’s SD-JWT-VC profile, with correct data types?
Per EW-DM-03-20/EW-DM-03-21, are all PID claims made selectively disclosable using the SD-JWT `_sd` mechanism? Which claims are excluded as issuer-protected (e.g., `vct`, `iss`, `cnf`)?
How do you handle date formatting requirements — do you use `full-date` format (YYYY-MM-DD) per RFC 3339 for all date attributes?
Have you validated SD-JWT VC output against reference parsers — specifically the EUDI Reference Implementation or equivalent conformance test suites?
Is SD-JWT VC compliance validation integrated into your CI/CD pipeline, running automatically against the official EUDI Reference Implementation test suite on every build?
How do you handle domestic PID type extensions — does the `vct` URN correctly extend `urn:eudi:pid:1` with a domestic type identifier?
Do you support key binding (KB-JWT) in SD-JWT VCs — is the `cnf` claim correctly populated with the device-bound public key or key reference?

VEND-ISS-035.text: Do you issue PIDs in ISO 18013-5 mDoc format compliant with ARF specifications? Is the `docType` correctly set to `eu.europa.ec.eudi.pid.1` (per EW-DM-03-07)?
Do you use correct element identifiers as defined in the PID Rulebook? Is CBOR encoding validated for correct data types (tstr, bstr, tdate, full-date-str, uint, bool)?
How do you handle CBOR encoding validation — do you run CBOR structure validators before IssuerAuth signing to catch encoding errors?
Per EW-DM-03-13, do you enforce element uniqueness — each PID contains at most one attribute with the same element identifier within any namespace?
Per EW-DM-03-06, how do you handle domestic namespace generation — appending ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g., `eu.europa.ec.eudi.pid.de.1` for Germany)?
Have you validated mDoc output against reference validators — specifically ISO 18013-5 test suites and the EUDI Reference Implementation?
How do you implement the Mobile Security Object (MSO) structure — per-attribute digests with correct salt generation (CSPRNG per AS-AP-10-056)?
Do you support portrait image encoding in mDoc format — correct CBOR data type (bstr), compression format (JPEG2000 or JPEG), and quality requirements per EW-DM-03-08/EW-DM-03-09?
Is mDoc format compliance validation integrated into your CI/CD pipeline, with automated testing against ISO 18013-5 conformance suites?

VEND-ISS-036.text: Do you support both the Attestation Status List mechanism and the Attestation Revocation List mechanism per AS-AP-07-019? Are both operational in production?

VEND-ISS-037.text: Do you implement all required elements of the OpenID4VCI protocol as specified in the ARF HLRs — including AS-AP-10-006/07 (issuance verification), AS-AP-10-023/18a (authorization flows), AS-AP-10-029-22b (access certificates), AS-AP-10-037/26 (credential offers), AS-AP-10-048/32a (deferred issuance)?
How do you structure credential offer payloads — attestation type, supported formats, issuer identifier, grant parameters? Do you support delivery via deep link, QR code, and push notification?

Per AS-AP-10-029/22a/22b, how do you include access certificates in Issuer metadata? Is the certificate chain verifiable by Wallet Units without external requests?
Do you support notification endpoints (AS-AP-10-037/26) for issuance status callbacks — can the Wallet Unit receive push notifications about credential readiness?

How do you prevent EAA user profiles from being merged with marketing or analytics databases — technical barriers (network segmentation, API gating), or organisational controls only?
What controls prevent sharing EAA user data with commercial partner systems — contractual prohibitions, technical enforcement, or both?
Can independent auditors verify data isolation compliance — is there a documented audit procedure, and what evidence is provided (data flow diagrams, access logs, architecture reviews)?
What are the consequences if data isolation is breached — automated detection, incident response procedures, notification to supervisory authorities?
How do you prevent EAA data from being used for AI/ML training on non-EAA services — is there a technical mechanism to exclude EAA data from training pipelines?
Do you perform regular data flow audits to verify no cross-service data leakage — automated scanning, penetration testing, or manual review?
How do you handle data isolation in development and testing environments — is production EAA data never used in non-EAA test environments?

VEND-ISS-039.text: How do you implement logical separation of EAA-related personal data from other data — separate database instances, separate schemas, logical partitioning, or data tagging?

Is the logical separation verifiable through technical audits — architecture documentation, penetration testing, automated compliance scanning of database permissions?
How does logical separation work in multi-tenant environments — per-tenant EAA data isolation, tenant-specific encryption keys, no cross-tenant data leakage?
What happens to data separation in backup and disaster recovery scenarios — EAA data backed up to separate media, recovery procedures tested for EAA-only restoration?
How do you ensure logical separation extends to log files and monitoring data — are EAA-related logs stored separately from non-EAA logs?
Do you provide architecture documentation demonstrating logical separation that can be shared with conformity assessment bodies?
How do you handle logical separation during database migrations or schema upgrades — is separation maintained throughout the migration process?

VEND-ISS-040.text: If offering QEAA services, how do you implement functional separation from other services per Article 45h(3) — organisational boundaries, technical infrastructure, governance structures?
Are QEAA operations handled by dedicated teams with clear organisational boundaries — separate management reporting lines, QEAA-specific HR processes?
Is QEAA infrastructure separated from non-QEAA infrastructure — separate servers, networks, HSMs, monitoring systems, deployment pipelines?
Are there independent governance structures for QEAA services — separate risk assessment, dedicated compliance monitoring, independent audit scope and reporting?
How is functional separation documented and audited for conformity assessment — is there a separation report that can be shared with supervisory authorities?
What level of personnel separation exists for QEAA operations — dedicated teams, split roles with access restrictions, or shared teams with compensating controls?

Do QEAA services have separate incident response procedures and communication channels — independent post-incident review processes?
How do you handle the Wallet Provider applicability of this requirement — per Article 5a(14), functional separation also applies to private Wallet Providers 'mutatis mutandis'?

VEND-ISS-041.text: Do you monitor the revocation status of Wallet Unit Attestations (WUAs) received during issuance for all active credentials? Per AS-WP-38-018, PID Providers SHALL regularly verify whether the Wallet Unit has been revoked — describe your monitoring mechanism (polling status lists, webhook notifications, or other).

What is your polling frequency for WUA revocation status lists? How do you balance revocation detection latency against the load on Wallet Provider status endpoints — and what is your effective worst-case cascading revocation latency?

Per AS-WP-38-019, Attestation Providers SHALL publish their policy regarding cascading revocation when a WUA is revoked. Have you published this policy? Where is it accessible to Relying Parties (e.g., in Provider Information, Trusted List metadata, or a public policy document)?

How does your platform handle the asymmetry between PID Providers (SHALL revoke) and Attestation Providers (MAY revoke) — is cascading revocation configurable per issuer role, or hardcoded by deployment type?

How do you store the WUA references received during issuance — do you persist the WUA itself, its status list URI and index, or a hash? How does this storage interact with AS-AP-10-058's requirement to discard unique elements after issuance?

When a WUA revocation is detected, how do you cross-reference all active credentials issued to that Wallet Unit — database lookup by WUA identifier, by Wallet Unit identifier, or by device binding key?

What is the operational process when cascading revocation is triggered — automatic revocation without human review, alert-and-approve workflow, or manual investigation? Is the revocation immediate per AS-WP-38-018's requirement?

How do you notify affected users when their attestations are cascade-revoked due to WUA revocation — push notification, email, in-app banner? Per EW-DM-38-015, the Wallet Provider must inform the user about wallet revocation separately, but do you also inform them about the resulting attestation revocation?

Do you log cascading revocation events with full traceability — the WUA revocation event that triggered the cascade, all affected credentials, revocation timestamps, and the policy basis (AS-WP-38-018 for PIDs, AS-WP-38-019 policy for EAAs)?

VEND-TSP-002.text: When was your last conformity assessment, and who conducted it? Is the CAB accredited under Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 for the relevant scope?

VEND-TSP-004.text: What QSCDs do you use for qualified signature and seal creation — specific make/model, certification level (Common Criteria EAL4+ with AVA_VAN.5)?

Do you perform regular penetration testing specifically targeting signature creation infrastructure — scope, frequency, third-party vs internal?

VEND-TSP-006.text: What is your Recovery Time Objective (RTO) for trust services — is it specified per service type (QES, QEAA, QTS)?

VEND-TSP-007.text: What is your process for detecting and classifying security breaches — classification levels (critical/high/medium/low), triage criteria, automated detection?
How do you ensure supervisory body notification within 24 hours — on-call procedures, pre-drafted notification templates, designated contact points?
Have you experienced any security breaches affecting trust services in the past 3 years? If so, what was the nature and impact?
How do you notify affected customers of security breaches — communication channels, timeline, content (scope, impact, remediation steps)?
What post-incident remediation and review processes do you follow — root cause analysis, corrective actions, lessons learned, process improvements?
How do you determine whether a breach has 'significant impact' per Article 19(2) — impact assessment criteria, number of affected users, service disruption threshold?
How do you handle the parallel GDPR Article 33 notification requirement (72 hours to DPA) if personal data is involved in the breach?
What is the content of your supervisory body notification — nature/scope of breach, detection time, affected systems, user count, measures taken?
Do you conduct regular breach simulation exercises (tabletop or live) to test your notification procedures and response times?

VEND-TSP-008.text: Do you offer remote qualified electronic signature services? If so, what is the volume of remote signatures processed monthly?
How do you implement the remote signature creation protocols specified in TS8 — Signature Activation Protocol (SAP), server-side QSCD management, transport encryption?
How is signature creation data (private keys) securely managed on behalf of signatories — HSM partition per signatory, shared HSM with logical separation, key lifecycle?
What authentication mechanisms are used to authorise remote signature creation — multi-factor (knowledge + possession + inherence), mobile app binding, OTP tokens?
Is your remote signing implementation certified by a conformity assessment body? Is the specific implementation explicitly named in the Conformity Assessment Report?
Is your specific implementation of 'Sole Control' (e.g., mobile app binding) explicitly named in your Conformity Assessment Report?
What session security measures are in place — session binding, timeout policies, re-authentication triggers, replay attack prevention?
How do you handle signatory onboarding for remote signing — identity verification, key generation ceremony, activation code delivery?
What availability SLA do you provide for remote signing services — uptime percentage, planned maintenance windows, geographic redundancy?

VEND-TSP-009.text: How do you ensure the signatory has sole control over the signature creation process — can you prove that even the QTSP itself cannot trigger signature creation without signatory authorisation?
What multi-factor authentication is required before signature creation — which factors (knowledge, possession, inherence), which specific mechanisms?
How is explicit consent obtained for each signature operation — per-document consent, batch consent (if allowed), consent UI design?
What audit trail exists for sole control verification — per-operation logs linking signatory authentication to signature creation, tamper-proof storage?
Is your sole control mechanism certified or audited by a CAB — specific standard (EN 419 241), certification level, validity period?
How do you prevent session hijacking or replay attacks against the sole control mechanism — session binding, nonce-based activation, time-limited SADs?
How do you handle sole control in batch signing scenarios — is per-document consent required, or can a signatory pre-authorise a batch?
What is the user experience for sole control — number of interaction steps, average time to complete a signature, mobile vs desktop?
How do you handle lost or compromised authentication factors — key recovery procedures, signatory re-enrolment, temporary signing block?

VEND-TSP-010.text: How do you present document content to signers before authorisation (WYSIWYS) — full document rendering, scrollable view, zoom capability?
What document formats are supported for WYSIWYS rendering — PDF, XML, Office documents? How do you handle format-specific rendering challenges?
How do you handle documents with dynamic content or hidden elements — JavaScript, macros, external references? Are these disabled or flagged?
Can signers scroll and review entire documents before signing — is there a mechanism to ensure the signer has viewed all pages?
How do you ensure the signed document matches what was displayed — hash verification between rendered view and signed data?
How do you handle accessibility requirements — screen reader compatibility, contrast, font sizes, keyboard navigation?
How do you render documents on mobile devices — responsive rendering, pinch-to-zoom, portrait/landscape orientation handling?
Do you support annotation or markup on documents before signing — signature position, date stamp, comments?
How do you handle multi-party signing — sequential presentation to each signer, visibility of other signers' signatures, countersigning?

VEND-TSP-011.text: Do you offer qualified electronic timestamp services? What is the volume of timestamps issued per day?
What time source do you use, and is it traceable to UTC — national metrology institute, GPS/GNSS, NTP stratum 1? How many redundant sources?
What is the accuracy of your timestamps — within ±1 second of UTC, or tighter? How do you verify and document accuracy?
How do you ensure timestamp data cannot be modified undetectably — tamper-evident logging, HSM-protected signing, hash chain integrity?
What is the availability SLA for your timestamp authority — uptime percentage, geographic redundancy, maximum response time?
Do you support long-term validation (LTV) — archival timestamp chains, re-timestamping services for signatures approaching algorithm deprecation?
What signing algorithm do you use for timestamps — RSA-PSS, ECDSA, EdDSA? Is PQC on your roadmap for timestamp signing?
How do you handle clock drift detection and correction — automatic drift monitoring, alarm thresholds, service suspension on drift?
What is the timestamp token format — RFC 3161, RFC 5544, or other? Is it compatible with standard timestamp verification libraries?

VEND-TSP-012.text: What authentic sources do you connect to for QEAA attribute verification — government registries, regulated entities, educational institutions, professional bodies?
How do you verify data provenance from authentic sources — secure API connections, mutual TLS, signed responses, audit chain?
What audit trail links QEAAs back to source verification — verification timestamp, source identifier, response hash, consent record?
How do you handle attributes not available from authentic sources (person-provided data) — identity verification procedures, evidence collection, liability?
What is the freshness of data from authentic sources at time of issuance — maximum delay between verification and attestation, caching policies?
How do you handle deferred verification responses from authentic sources — polling mechanism, maximum wait time, fallback procedures?
How do you implement data minimisation when querying authentic sources — request only needed attributes, avoid unnecessary data collection?
What happens if an authentic source returns a negative or partial verification — issuance refusal, partial attestation, user notification?
Do you support cross-border authentic source access — sources in other Member States, language handling, data format translation?

VEND-TSP-013.text: Do you sign QEAAs with a qualified electronic signature or qualified electronic seal? Which one, and why?
What signing algorithm and key length do you use for QEAA signatures — ECDSA P-256/P-384, EdDSA Ed25519, RSA-PSS ≥3072-bit?
Is Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) on your roadmap for QEAA signing algorithms — hybrid signatures (classical + PQC), migration timeline?
Is your QEAA signing certificate included in Member State Trusted Lists — can RPs verify the certificate via the LOTL chain?
What is your key rotation schedule for QEAA signing keys — planned frequency, emergency rotation procedures, overlap period?
Do you support 'pre-hashing' of large datasets on the client side before submission to reduce bandwidth and privacy exposure?
How do you handle signing for both mDoc and SD-JWT-VC formats — same signing key, separate keys per format, algorithm compatibility?
What is your signing throughput — signatures per second, queue management, performance under peak load?
How do you handle Trusted List update propagation after key rotation — coordination with supervisory body, notification to RPs, transition period?

VEND-TSP-014.text: What revocation mechanisms do you provide for QEAAs — Attestation Status List, Attestation Revocation List, short-lived attestations (≤24 hours), or a combination?
How frequently are revocation status lists updated — publication interval, event-driven updates, configurable per attestation type?
What is the maximum propagation time for QEAA revocation — time from revocation decision to status list availability, compliance with ETSI EN 319 411-1 REV-6.2.4-03A?
How do Relying Parties access your QEAA revocation information — HTTP endpoints, caching policies, format (Attestation Status List bitstring, CRL)?
Do you support QEAA suspension in addition to permanent revocation — temporary revocation with reinstatement capability?
What triggers automatic revocation — key compromise, authentic source data change, issuer decision, user request, attestation expiry?
How do you handle batch revocation scenarios — mass revocation of many attestations simultaneously, performance impact, notification procedures?
What privacy properties does your revocation mechanism provide — herd privacy (RP cannot determine which index was checked), access logging?
What is the availability SLA for your revocation/status endpoints — uptime, geographic redundancy, maximum response time?

VEND-TSP-015.text: What liability insurance coverage do you maintain for qualified trust services — policy type, insurer, coverage scope?
What is the coverage limit and scope of your liability insurance — per-incident cap, aggregate annual cap, geographic scope?
Can you provide proof of current insurance coverage — certificate of insurance, policy summary, coverage confirmation letter?
How do you demonstrate adequate financial resources beyond insurance — financial statements, reserves, parent company guarantees?
What is the claims process if a customer experiences damages — claims submission, investigation timeline, compensation mechanism?
Is your insurance coverage proportionate to the volume and value of trust services provided — how is adequacy assessed?
Does your insurance specifically cover EUDI Wallet ecosystem risks — QEAA mis-issuance, access certificate failures, cross-border liability?
What is the insurance renewal cycle — annual, multi-year? Has coverage ever lapsed or been refused?
How do you handle liability allocation in multi-party scenarios — joint liability with other QTSPs, intermediaries, or Wallet Providers?

VEND-TSP-016.text: Do you accept liability for qualified services as specified in eIDAS Article 13 — presumed liability unless you prove no negligence?
What limitations on liability exist in your standard contract terms — are any eIDAS-mandated obligations excluded or limited?
How do you handle claims for damages arising from verification or revocation failures — claims process, investigation, remediation?
What indemnification provisions do you offer — scope, caps, exclusions, process for triggering indemnification?
Have there been any liability claims against your trust services in the past 5 years? If so, what was the nature and outcome?
How do you differentiate liability between qualified and non-qualified trust services — different contractual terms, insurance coverage?
Do you accept liability for QEAAs based on incorrect authentic source data — where does liability transfer occur between QTSP and authentic source?
How is liability communicated to relying parties — terms of service, reliance limits, liability caps for certificate-based reliance?
What dispute resolution mechanism is in your contracts — mediation, arbitration, jurisdiction, governing law?

VEND-TSP-017.text: If acting as an Access Certificate Authority (ACA), do you comply with the Commission's common Certificate Policy per AS-MS-27-015? Can you demonstrate compliance?
What certificate issuance procedures do you follow — registration authority processes, identity verification, certificate request validation?
How do you provide certificate validation services — OCSP, CRL, or both? What are the response times and availability SLAs?
What is your certificate revocation process and timeline — maximum time from revocation request to CRL/OCSP update?
How do you support ecosystem participants in verifying access certificates — validation endpoints, trust chain documentation, integration libraries?
Per AS-MS-27-016, do you log all issued access certificates for Certificate Transparency (CT) per Topic 55 requirements? Which CT logs do you use?
What certificate profiles do you support — PID Provider certificates, Attestation Provider certificates, Relying Party certificates, intermediary certificates?
How do you handle cross-border certificate recognition — is your ACA included in the LOTL, are certificates verifiable across all Member States?
What is your certificate renewal process — automated renewal, manual re-application, grace period, overlap with existing certificates?

VEND-TSP-018.text: What notification process do you follow if your trust services are suspended or cancelled — customer notification timeline, supervisory body coordination?
What transition procedures ensure continuity for customers during suspension/cancellation — alternative provider referrals, migration support?
How long are certificates/attestations still verifiable after service cancellation — revocation list maintenance, OCSP responder availability?
What arrangements exist for archive and repository access after service termination — data retention period, access procedures, Trusted Archivist?
Have you ever had trust services suspended? If so, what were the circumstances and how was service restored?
Per EW-DM-31-001, if acting as an ACA, are you prepared to immediately revoke ALL temporally valid access certificates upon suspension — operational readiness, automation?
Per AS-MS-31-019, if acting as a Provider of registration certificates, are you prepared to immediately revoke ALL valid registration certificates and prohibit registry access upon suspension?
What is your customer impact mitigation plan — advance notice for planned changes, alternative provider list, automated migration tools?
How do you handle the downstream impact on intermediaries and relying parties who depend on your certificates — communication plan, transition timeline?

VEND-TSP-019.text: How do you implement the technical interfaces for authentic source access per ARF Topic 42 — AS-AP-42-001 technical specifications, discovery mechanism?
How do you obtain and record User consent per AS-AP-42-009 — informed consent (user understands what is verified), specific (per-attribute/per-request), auditable?
How do you process verification responses per AS-AP-42-004/05 — positive, negative, partial data, deferred (polling with unique identifier)?
What authentic source response types can you handle — positive verification, negative verification, partial data, source unavailability?
How do you handle authentic source unavailability or errors — retry logic, fallback procedures, user notification, issuance deferral?
Per AS-AP-42-005, do you send verification requests directly to the Authentic Source or designated intermediary — no additional intermediaries in the chain?
How do you discover Authentic Sources at national level — registry lookup, pre-configured endpoints, dynamic discovery per AS-AP-42-001?
What security measures protect the authentic source communication channel — mutual TLS, signed requests/responses, encryption in transit?
How do you handle cross-border authentic source access — sources in other Member States, language handling, data format normalisation?
